note: T-Mobile shared no taxonomy, so these are ours, based on common US smishing types (A21). The classifier and Nemotron may output only these ids. `subtypes` steer the A21 generator; they are not output labels. Every scam category has matching hard legitimate look-alikes under `legit`.

categories.label: Bank impersonation
categories.description: Pretends to be a bank or card issuer: fraud alert, locked or suspended account, card declined, verify your identity, confirm a charge by link or callback.
subtypes: fraud alert asking to verify a charge
callback number for the fraud team

categories.label: Fake bill or payment demand
categories.description: Fake bill, overdue balance or failed payment from a phone carrier, utility, or subscription, with a threat of shut-off and a link to pay.
subtypes: overdue phone bill with suspension threat
streaming or software subscription renewal failed

categories.label: Fake delivery notice
categories.description: Fake package or postal notice: missed delivery, address problem, customs or redelivery fee, package held.

categories.label: Fake account security alert
categories.description: Pretends to protect a non-bank account (carrier, Apple, Amazon, email, social media): login alert, password reset, SIM change, or asks the person to send back a one-time code.
subtypes: asks the person to reply with a verification code
account will be deleted or disabled
suspicious order placed on your account

categories.label: Fake toll or government notice
categories.description: Pretends to be a toll agency, the IRS, DMV, court, or another government office: unpaid toll, tax refund or debt, license suspension, fines.

categories.label: Fake prize, reward or refund
categories.description: Promises money or a gift: prize or giveaway winner, expiring reward points, gift card, unclaimed refund, survey reward.
subtypes: free gift card for a survey

categories.label: Fake job or easy money offer
categories.description: Unsolicited job or income offer: remote task jobs with daily pay, recruiter who wants to move to a chat app, reshipping, crypto or investment opportunities.
subtypes: remote part-time task job with daily pay
recruiter asks to continue on a chat app
product review or app rating job

categories.label: Wrong-number or family impersonation
categories.description: Starts a personal conversation to build trust: a fake wrong-number text, a relative or friend writing from a 'new number' who needs money, or a romance opener.
subtypes: relative on a new number needs money urgently

categories.label: Legitimate message
categories.description: Real messages people get, including hard look-alikes of every scam category above.
subtypes: real-style bank transaction or balance alert
real-style bank fraud check that asks only for a YES or NO reply
carrier bill ready or autopay confirmation
carrier data usage or plan notice
one-time passcode with a do-not-share warning
delivery update from a carrier or retailer
toll account statement or auto-replenish notice
retail promotion or loyalty points update
personal message from a friend or family member
